[curious, lively, starts speaking immediately] That panicked call might not be your grandson. Scammers can now clone a voice from a short clip posted online. The call is always urgent. An accident, an arrest, a trip gone wrong, and please, do not tell anyone. Then comes the ask: money that is hard to get back, like a wire transfer, gift cards, or crypto. The fix is low tech. Agree on a family safe word, and ask for it on any emergency call. No safe word? Hang up, and call back on a number you know is real. That call might not be family.
